title: FileBrowser cache-hit path does not clear a stale error, leaving a successfully-loaded directory hidden behind a stale error banner
description: In the FileBrowser effect, the cache-hit fast path (`if (cached) { setItems(...); setLoading(false); return }`) returns without calling `setError(null)`. Only the cache-miss branch resets the error (line 189). Because the render checks `error` BEFORE `items` (lines 250-251), a stale error from a previously-failed directory persists and masks the cached content of a different, successfully-loaded directory.
evidence: Reachable sequence: (1) User is in directory B which loads OK and is cached (setFileListCache, line 195; cache TTL 30s per useSettingsStore.getFileListCache). (2) User navigates into subdir A; A's listFiles rejects -> catch sets error + items=[] (lines 200-201); note A is NOT cached on failure. (3) User clicks goUp back to B; goUp sets loading(true) then setDir(B) (lines 211-212). (4) Effect re-runs for B, getFileListCache(B) hits -> setItems(B), setLoading(false), `return` at line 187 WITHOUT setError(null). Render at lines 250-251 evaluates `error ? <error> : items...`, so B's valid cached rows are hidden behind A's stale error banner until the 30s cache expires or `extensions` changes. The cache-miss branch clears error (line 189) but the cache-hit branch does not.
